notes: Per-PC settings for test-console\desk.ps1 (privateAI-design-31 s5). Copy to config/local/desk.json (git-ignored) and edit. secretsDir holds the *.env files read BY NAME (values never printed): paidJobs.secretsFile needs PAID_JOBS, PAID_JOBS_KEY, PAID_JOBS_RESULT_URL; adminUi.secretsFile is near-watch's env file (NEAR_WATCH_INGEST_KEY, ADMIN_API_KEY, NEAR_PAY_TO_TESTNET); paywall.nearEnvFile is the NEAR rail file for stack.ps1 -NearEnvFile. Fees are YOUR prices, written as text numbers (no defaults by design, ARCH-114). modelsFile/defaultModel 'auto' follow the gateway's current model set. paywall.nearRpcCandidates: NEAR testnet RPCs in order of preference (public endpoints from docs.near.org/api/rpc/providers); desk.ps1 tests them from inside the paywall and gives it the first that answers, so a rate-limited RPC (FastNEAR is also used by near-watch on this PC) never refuses payments. The adminUI checkout comes from config/local/repos.json (nearWatchDir). runLog: off | meta (no data values) | full (synthetic data only).
